==Purpose of template==
Get all quotes that match a tag.

==How to use==

<pre>
{{wotqs|tags}}
{{wotqs|{{PAGENAME}}}}
</pre>

==Examples==

{| class="wikitable"
| Description
| Code
| Result
|-
| 
| <pre>{{wotqs|Mat}}</pre>
|      {{wotqs|Mat}}
|-
<!-- Slow
| 
| <pre>{{wotqs|all
!Rand}}</pre>
|      {{wotqs|all
!Rand}}
|-
-->
|-
| No quotes found
| <pre>{{wotqs|oajwofiawoief}}</pre>
|      {{wotqs|oajwofiawoief}}
|-
|}
